title: Where Am I?
story: Your first ticket simply says: "Check where the onboarding shell dropped you." The documentation, naturally, does not say.
objective: Print the absolute path of your current directory.
hints: The command name is short for print working directory.
explanation: pwd prints the shell's current working directory. It is a useful first check whenever a path-sensitive command behaves unexpectedly.

files.content: Welcome to ByteWorks. Please ignore the smoke.
